# GREEN Bio Cosmetics

> Small Moroccan brand of natural cosmetics, handmade in small batches. Savon beldi (black olive hammam soap), Fez lipstick, pure argan oil, ghassoul hair rituals and soothing skincare. Ordering and delivery arranged directly over WhatsApp.

- Website: https://green-biocosmetics.vercel.app
- Phone / WhatsApp: +212 723-293972 (answers daily 9:00–20:00)
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/green.biocosmetics
- Languages: French, English
- Based in: Morocco (Tanger)
- Delivery: within Morocco, arranged per order on WhatsApp

## Products

- **Savon Beldi & Kessa** — traditional black olive hammam soap with an exfoliating kessa glove.
- **Fez Lipstick** — natural terracotta-red balm lipstick, one signature shade.
- **Pure Argan Oil** — multipurpose oil for hair, face and nails.
- **Hair Ritual — Ghassoul & Oils** — rhassoul clay wash with nourishing oils.
- **Soothing Face Cream** — calming face cream with orange blossom and aloe.

All products are 100% natural, made by hand, with no sulfates or silicones. Prices and stock are confirmed per order on WhatsApp.
